stem_book: The solution of (sin x − 2)^(2) + (cos x − 3/2)^(2) = 0 is: (a) x = π/2 (b) x = π (c) x = π/4 (d) No solution
reason: Printed key c (π/4), but a sum of squares = 0 needs sin x = 2, impossible (also cos x = 3/2) ⇒ no solution (d); at π/4 LHS ≈ 2.2 ≠ 0.
work: both squares must vanish ⇒ sin x = 2 and cos x = 3/2, both outside [−1, 1] ⇒ no solution
